method: weights.csv_direct_NAV_reconstruction_with_15bps_cost_15bps_one_way (Charter §9 SoT — period_returns from RAWDATA Date>start_d slicing per strategy variant, all 7 sharing common measurement basis)

matrix.primary_rationale: M4+LRO_cap conservative (Plan §1 baseline_decision_basis) — combines proven M4 outer regime cash defense with LRO state-conditional active_cap intervention (0.20→0.15 in HighRisk/Extreme).

LRO_mon.note: Mode A — weight identical to S1; LRI observed but not acted upon

LRO_cap.note: Mode B — cap-only (0.20→0.15) in HighRisk/Extreme. MARGINALLY WORSE than S1 — cap intervention does not address MKT-driven crisis

LRO_cash.note: Cash overlay — cash% 0/5/15/25 by LRI state. -495bp MDD vs S1 / -84bp Sharpe vs M4

M4+LRO_cap.note: PRIMARY CANONICAL — M4 cash + LRO active_cap. SR/MDD virtually identical to M4 alone (cap intervention adds <8bp drag)

M4+LRO_cash.note: M4 cash ⊕ LRO cash via max() — best Sharpe (+6bp vs M4) + best MDD (-41bp vs M4) but CAGR -152bp vs M4 (cash drag)

common_basis.rebalance_rule: monthly_signal_t-1_close_to_t_open (signal-to-action lag enforced by period_data Date>start_d)

active_cap_per_strategy.audit_note: LRO_cap variants reduce cap to 0.15 ONLY in HighRisk/Extreme LRI months (34/269 = 12.6% schedule). All other months use 0.20 baseline. Verified by inspection of weights_summary.max_weight_per_date_min_max in optimization_package.json (LRO_cap max=0.0985 because top-name TIE not 0.15-binding in schedule).

m4_baseline_recomputed.rationale: M4 baseline re-computed by forge under IDENTICAL measurement basis as 7 LRO strategies — used as PASS gate Core baseline for AX-001 v2 defense-like evaluation (Plan §1 baseline_decision_basis row).

l274_frozen_reference.use: frozen historical reference for transparency only. NOT used as PASS/FAIL gate (Plan §5 #8). Difference vs forge re-computed M4 is 06_metrics-style measurement variance, NOT pure_function_violation.

vs_factor_engine.rationale: L-274 documented baseline (43.78/1.7477) vs forge re-computed (43.15/1.5855) — difference Sharpe 0.162 / CAGR 0.63pp / MDD 0.90pp. STR_1715 06_metrics.csv reports 43.91/1.524/41.69 — multiple measurement variants exist. forge measurement uses period_returns end-of-month + cost-deducted ret_net → Charter v1.4 §12 SR formula. Difference is MEASUREMENT DRIFT (period boundary / Charter SR) not fabrication. WT-S20260503_002 baseline_metrics_reconcile separates this concern.

LRO_cap.verdict_3_tuple: FAIL — MDD WORSE than M4 (-8.17pp), no crisis_alpha improvement vs S1, bad/normal vol ratio 1.68× shows LRI predicts risk but cap-only does not act effectively

LRO_cash.verdict_3_tuple: PARTIAL — GFC crisis_alpha +9.36pp vs S1 (cash overlay reduces drawdown), but MDD slightly WORSE than M4 (-2.75pp). Compresses bad-state vol 1.36× ratio (better than LRO_cap)

M4+LRO_cap.verdict_3_tuple: MARGINAL — virtually identical to M4 alone (MDD diff -0.08pp, Sharpe diff -0.022). LRO cap tightening adds NO meaningful improvement when M4 cash overlay already active

M4+LRO_cash.verdict_3_tuple: BEST OF FOUR — only variant with positive MDD pp improvement vs M4 (+0.42pp) AND best bad/normal vol ratio compression (1.38× vs M4-implied ratio). But CAGR cost -152bp

primary_canonical_M4_LRO_cap.interpretation: LRI predictive power confirmed: HighRisk forward 1M vol 1.68× Normal. Extreme paradoxically lower than HighRisk — suggests LRI Extreme captures POST-stress recovery state (mean-reverting dynamic), not pre-stress signal

subperiod_robustness.interpretation: ex-Semi removal weakens performance (Sharpe drop 1.583→1.458) — confirms semi/IT family is alpha contributor not just risk factor. ex-Samsung_Hynix retains performance (Sharpe 1.583→1.568).

pass_gate_handoff_to_judge.judge_input_summary: RECOMMENDED_ACTION = KEEP (continue STR_1715 100% PG2 with M4 schedule). LRO does not provide evidence sufficient to justify CAP_TIGHTEN or CASH_OVERLAY adoption. CONDITIONAL_PASS may be considered for M4+LRO_cash as an OOS monitoring add-on if judge weights MDD priority over CAGR.
